Methodology & data coverage +

USDC supply. Live totalSupply() and decimals() reads at one block from Arc’s native USDC ERC-20 interface. This is the same underlying USDC as native gas balances, not an additional wrapped asset. If RPC fails, the latest DefiLlama USDC observation is explicitly labeled as an indexed fallback.

DeFi TVL. DefiLlama’s Arc chain aggregate, across all tracked assets at their USD prices. It is not USDC-only liquidity or a sum of this page’s rows. Protocol tables use only chainTvls.Arc, never multichain totals or borrowed/staking suffixes. Curators and yield aggregators can overlap; their rows are labeled and are not added to the headline.

Morpho vaults. The first 100 Arc V2 vaults returned by Morpho’s API, sorted here by reported totalAssetsUsd. Default display requires at least $1,000; the expansion button includes smaller indexed vaults. Names are supplied by the API and are not an endorsement. Vault assets overlap with core lending markets and must not be summed into chain TVL.

Freshness. Refreshes every five minutes while this page is open. RPC is live; DefiLlama and Morpho are indexed and may lag. Historical supply is DefiLlama circulating USDC, which can differ from the live contract supply. Daily dates use UTC. Unavailable sources are labeled rather than replaced with zero.
